people.name: Hamor
people.line: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: Founded the city where Dinah was raped

translations.web: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
translations.bsb: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”
translations.kjv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
translations.asv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
